answer: Make standing fade like a comet tail unless constantly renewed: a newcomer earns trust only by proving live presence at rotating ivory checkpoints, each visit requiring a fresh job checked by a stranger on site. The visit is sealed with a plume token signed by that stranger, binding the proof to one key and one moment, so a recorded visit cannot be replayed. An identity that skips its checkpoint sees its standing shrink, and idle clones fade away on their own. Sybil farms must staff every clone at scattered checkpoints and redo real work for each, costing more than honest work pays.
